2607.21999.title: From Perturbation Correction to Geometry-Aware Sampling: Sharpness-Guided Equilibrium Sampling for Balanced Flat Minima in Long-Tailed Learning
2607.21999.paper_summary: Long-tailed learning couples two sources of poor generalization: head classes dominate training exposure, while under-represented classes often converge to sharper regions of the loss landscape. Conventional re-sampling addresses the former without considering geometry, whereas existing long-tailed sharpness-aware minimization (SAM) methods modify losses or perturbations only after biased mini-batches have been drawn. We introduce Sharpness-Guided Equilibrium Sampling (SGS), which treats the sampling distribution as an active control variable for optimization geometry. SGS dynamically adjusts subsequent mini-batches by increasing the sampling probability of less frequently sampled classes while suppressing classes with large SAM-induced loss changes, using only cumulative class counts and EMA sharpness estimates obtained from the standard SAM update, without class-wise perturbations or additional backward passes. We characterize this sampling process through a continuous-time stochastic differential equation and a sampling-dependent PAC-Bayes analysis, explaining how frequency-sharpness feedback can move training toward a more balanced flatness profile. On CIFAR-100 LT with an imbalance ratio of 100, SGS-SAM improves Focal-SAM by 10.85 points in tail accuracy and 3.56 points overall. On ImageNet-LT, it improves ImbSAM by 6.59 points on tail classes and 1.20 points overall. Its training time is only $1.02\times$ that of vanilla SAM. Beyond these gains, SGS establishes a sampling-side route to loss-landscape control, suggesting that future long-tailed methods can jointly regulate data exposure and optimization geometry rather than treating either as fixed.
2607.21999.paper_summary_zh: 長尾學習結合了兩個導致泛化不良的來源：頭類別主導了訓練暴露，而代表性不足的類別則往往收斂到損失景觀的尖銳區域。傳統的重取樣方法解決了前者，但未考慮幾何形狀，而現有的長尾尖銳度感知最小化（SAM）方法僅在偏見的小批量被抽取後才修改損失或擾動。我們引入了尖銳度引導的平衡取樣（SGS），將取樣分布視為優化幾何形狀的主動控制變量。SGS通過提高較少被取樣類別的取樣概率，同時抑制產生大SAM引起的損失變化的類別，動態調整後續的小批量，僅使用累積的類別計數和從標準SAM更新中獲得的EMA尖銳度估計，而不需要類別級的擾動或額外的反向傳播。我們通過連續時間隨機微分方程和依賴於取樣的PAC-Bayes分析來表徵這一取樣過程，解釋頻率-尖銳度反饋如何使訓練朝向更平衡的平坦度輪廓移動。在CIFAR-100 LT上，失衡比率為100，SGS-SAM在尾部準確率上提高了Focal-SAM 10.85點，整體提高了3.56點。在ImageNet-LT上，它在尾部類別上提高了ImbSAM 6.59點，整體提高了1.20點。其訓練時間僅為原始SAM的$1.02\times$。除了這些增益外，SGS建立了一條取樣側的損失景觀控制路徑，暗示未來的長尾方法可以共同調節數據暴露和優化幾何形狀，而不是將其視為固定的。
2607.21999.author: Jiaxin Deng et.al.
